ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS2 is an experimental JobGiver stutter-reduction build for RimWorld 1.5, continuing from the successful JS1/V0.4.18.2 line. JS1 telemetry showed that broad ShouldSkip/HasJobOnCell/HasJobOnThing memoization had only a 2.5% overall hit rate, while JobPackage-local nearest-order reuse reached 37.6%. JS2 therefore removes ShouldSkip and HasJobOnCell memoization, retains only parity-sampled HasJobOnThing reuse, and replaces maxDistance-specific ordering entries with an exact source+root search plan. One distance-sorted plan can serve multiple maxDistance prefixes during the same synchronous TryIssueJobPackage call. Every plan reuse fully revalidates source membership, Spawned state and positions before use. GenClosest validators, Reachability, final target selection, Job creation, reservations and mutable game state remain Vanilla/main-thread authoritative. No cache survives the JobPackage boundary, the low-yield cross-package async candidate-plan experiment remains retired, ReachProfile behavior remains the validated V0.4.18.2 path, and Path worker results remain shadow-only.
